phantom.name: Ghost
phantom.desc: You plow through the horde: -20% damage taken and +10% evasion.

persevere.name: Perseverance
persevere.desc: +60% experience. With it, it reaches a fearsome evolution before anyone else (Lv. 40).

steadfast-aura.name: Steadfast Aura
steadfast-aura.desc: +12% evasion. Every dodge gives you +6% damage for 4 s (stackable).

mew.name: Ancestral Gene
mew.desc: +10% damage, speed, area and HP. Can learn moves of any type.

loyal-guard.name: Loyal Guardian
loyal-guard.desc: +10% speed. Every 3 s, nearby enemies are intimidated (they deal -40% damage).

beacon.name: Beacon
beacon.desc: +3 pickup range. Paralyzed enemies take +25% damage. Every 5 s, your wool lets off sparks that paralyze nearby enemies.

mud-trail.name: Mud
mud-trail.desc: +10% HP. As you move you leave a trail of mud that damages and roots enemies.

bone-keeper.name: Guardian Bone
bone-keeper.desc: +10 armor. Your bone attacks deal +20% damage. Below 40% HP, +35% damage.

blessing.name: Serene Grace
blessing.desc: +50% status chance and +25 luck (better items and offers).

gem-hoarder.name: Jeweler
gem-hoarder.desc: +30% PokéDollars and +2 pickup range. +1% damage for every 25 ₽ you carry (up to +25%).

horn-pride.name: Antlers
horn-pride.desc: +15% physical damage. Every KO powers you up: more damage and speed (up to +30%).

presage.name: Omen
presage.desc: +8% crit. Your crits finish off enemies with less than 12% HP (not bosses).

dragon-dream.name: Dream of Flight
dragon-dream.desc: +1 jump and +10% physical damage. When you land from a height you create a shockwave. As Salamence, it can finally fly.

iron-body.name: Iron Body
iron-body.desc: +18 armor. Levitate with magnetism: hold Jump to glide, and you can climb walls.

metamorph.name: Metamorphosis
metamorph.desc: +15% experience and +20 shield. Evolves soon (Metapod at Lv. 8, Butterfree at Lv. 36). As Metapod, the cocoon gives you +30 armor.

venom-sting.name: Poison Sting
venom-sting.desc: +10% attack speed. Your crits poison and poisoned enemies take +20% damage. Evolves soon (Kakuna at Lv. 8, Beedrill at Lv. 36); as Kakuna, +30 armor.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.desc: +12% speed, +20% projectile speed and +1 jump. Like any good Flying type, you glide by holding Jump.

serpent-glare.name: Serpent Glare
serpent-glare.desc: +1 regen (Shed Skin). Every 4 s your gaze paralyzes the enemies in front of you (7 m).

sand-rush.name: Sand Rush
sand-rush.desc: +10 armor and +6% crit. In a sandstorm, +30% speed.

lunar-blessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunar-blessing.desc: +20 luck and +1 regen. Your Ultimate charges 30% faster and when you cast it you recover 15% HP.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.desc: +10% speed and +1 regen. In sun, +30% speed and +20% damage. Every 6 s you release a pollen cloud (4.5 m) that poisons.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.desc: +20% status chance. Anyone who touches you falls asleep, gets paralyzed or gets poisoned. As Parasect, the mushroom is in control: +20% damage against enemies with any status.

compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.desc: +8% crit and +15% status chance. Confused enemies take +25% damage. As Venomoth, +12% attack speed.

arena-trap.name: Sand Trap
arena-trap.desc: +10 armor. Every 2 s the ground shakes around you (4.5 m): it damages and traps enemies in the sand (root). As Dugtrio, 6 m.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.desc: +40% PokéDollars and +2 pickup. Every 100 ₽ you earn in a run gives you +1% crit (up to +15%). As Persian, +10% speed.

headache.name: Headache
headache.desc: +10% HP. The hits you take and the passage of time charge your headache; when full, it bursts into a psychic wave (7 m) that damages and confuses. As Golduck, the wave is 10 m and heals you for 8%.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.desc: +8 armor. Every hit you take enrages you: +6% damage per charge (up to 6; as Primeape, up to 8). The rage fades after 5 s without taking damage.

swift-swim.name: Swift Swim
swift-swim.desc: +10% HP and +20% projectile speed. In rain, +30% speed and +20% damage. As Poliwrath, +15% physical damage.

carnivore.name: Hungry Maw
carnivore.desc: +10% HP. Your Strikes and Spins deal +15% damage and can root (20%). KOs of rooted enemies heal you for 2% of HP.

tentacles.name: Tentacles
tentacles.desc: +10 armor. Every 2 s your tentacles lash the 2 closest enemies within 7 m (they poison); Tentacruel lashes 4.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: You float: hold Jump to glide and you can climb walls. +6% evasion.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: Every 3 s, nearby enemies are charmed (they deal -40% damage).

pressure.desc: +25% damage to elites, Alphas and bosses.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: You survive a lethal hit with 1 HP once per run. +10 armor.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.desc: +15% HP and +10 armor. Anyone who touches you is poisoned, and poisoned enemies spread it when they die.

static.name: Static
static.desc: Anyone who touches you is paralyzed. Every 4 s you fire a discharge at an enemy.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.desc: Anyone who touches you is charmed. +5% evasion.

inner-focus.desc: +10% damage and you can't be knocked back.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.desc: +25% HP, +1.5 regen and -10% speed. Every 6 s you yawn: enemies within 6 m may fall asleep. As Slowbro, the Shellder on its tail gives you +20 armor.

natural-cure.name: Lucky Egg
natural-cure.desc: +40% HP and +40% healing. Every 10 s you lay an egg beside you that heals you for 10% when picked up.

hyper-cutter.name: Giant Pincer
hyper-cutter.desc: +6 armor. Your Strikes deal +20% damage. Every 5th hit of a Strike is a pincer that deals double damage and stuns (Kingler, every 4th).

beast-boost.desc: Every KO makes you faster and stronger (up to +30%).

rock-head.name: Rock Head
rock-head.desc: +25 armor and +15% HP, in exchange for -8% speed. Your Charges deal +30% damage. Every 6 s rocks fall on the 3 closest enemies.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.desc: +25% physical damage and +10% attack speed, in exchange for -8% HP.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.desc: +10% damage and +25% against elites, Alphas and bosses.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.desc: Anyone who touches you is burned. Burned enemies you defeat burst into flames (3 m) and burn those around them.

battle-armor.name: Fossil Armor
battle-armor.desc: +15 armor. Each hit you take is reduced by 3 + 0.3 per level. As Kabutops, your Strikes and Boomerangs deal +20% damage.

healer.desc: Every 6 s you recover 5% of HP. +20% healing.

mold-breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.desc: +15% damage. You ignore enemy shields (like Fighting attacks) and deal +20% to bosses and mini-bosses. Storm Throw is always a crit.

iron-fist.name: Iron Fist
iron-fist.desc: +5% physical damage. Your punches (attacks with "punch") deal +20% damage. Every 3 s you throw an automatic punch at the closest enemy within 4 m.

magnet-pull.name: Magnet
magnet-pull.desc: +4 pickup range. Every 4 s a magnetic pulse pulls in enemies within 9 m and may paralyze them. As Magneton, the pulse also damages them.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.desc: Your speed and damage increase over time (up to +30%).

rough-skin.desc: Anyone who touches you takes damage (thorns +30).

iron-barbs.desc: Anyone who touches you takes damage (thorns +30).

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.desc: +25% damage with moves of your own type (the type bonus goes from ×1.25 to ×1.56).

skill-link.name: Skill Link
skill-link.desc: +20 armor and +1 projectile. As Cloyster, +1 projectile and +10 more armor.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.desc: At full HP you take -50% damage.

magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.desc: Immune to damage from the ground (lava, fire pools, cracks, spore clouds). -30% damage from projectiles and area attacks.

moxie.desc: Every KO powers you up (up to +30% damage).

shadow-tag.desc: When you dodge, the attacker takes Ghost damage.

water-veil.name: Water Veil
water-veil.desc: +10% evasion. Every dodge wraps you in water: a shield worth 6% of your HP. As Seaking, +5% evasion.

ice-body.name: Polar Fat
ice-body.desc: +15% HP and +10 armor. Every 4 s ice shards burst around you (5 m) and gradually freeze enemies. As Dewgong, 6.5 m.

blazing-hooves.name: Fiery Hooves
blazing-hooves.desc: +15% speed. As you move you leave fire footprints that burn enemies. As Rapidash, +10% speed and bigger footprints.

leek-master.name: Sharpened Leek
leek-master.desc: +10% crit. You always carry a leek: 4% of your hits are an ×8 "Bonk!" (stacks with the Leek item).

twin-heads.name: Twin Heads
twin-heads.desc: +10% speed. Each attack has a 25% chance to repeat instantly with the other head. As Dodrio, 35%.

sludge-body.name: Muddy Body
sludge-body.desc: -15% damage taken. When hit, you leave a toxic puddle for 4 s that poisons and traps anyone who steps in it. As Muk, the puddles are bigger.

pendulum.name: Pendulum
pendulum.desc: +10% status chance. Every 7 s your pendulum puts the 3 closest enemies to sleep (Hypno, 5). Sleeping enemies within 6 m heal you for 0.5% of HP per second each (up to 5).

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.desc: +15% speed. Enemies you defeat have a 12% chance to explode (3 m, Electric damage that paralyzes); with Electrode, 20%.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.desc: +20% healing. Every 15 s a berry appears beside you. As Exeggutor, +10% area.

limber-kicks.name: Rubber Kicks
limber-kicks.desc: +20% area and +1 jump. Your kicks (attacks with "kick") deal +20% damage.

long-tongue.name: Long Tongue
long-tongue.desc: +4 pickup range and +20% HP. Every 4 s your tongue grabs the closest enemy within 8 m, pulls it toward you and paralyzes it.

toxic-cloud.name: Toxic Cloud
toxic-cloud.desc: You levitate: hold Jump to glide and you can climb walls. A 4 m gas cloud surrounds you and poisons every second. As Weezing, 5.5 m.

rhino-charge.name: Unstoppable Charge
rhino-charge.desc: +15 armor. After 1.5 s of running without stopping, you charge: enemies you touch take damage and are sent flying.

regenerator.name: Vines
regenerator.desc: +2 regen. Every 5 s your vines trap (root) and damage the 4 closest enemies within 7 m.

parental-bond.name: Parental Bond
parental-bond.desc: Your baby fights alongside you: every hit of your attacks is repeated at 25% of its damage.

ink-sniper.name: Ink
ink-sniper.desc: +10% crit and +25% crit damage. Your crits cover the enemy in ink and blind it: it deals -40% damage and common enemies stop attacking.

star-core.name: Core
star-core.desc: +20% projectile speed. Every 8 s your core heals you for 5%. As Starmie, +10% special damage.

barrier-wall.name: Invisible Wall
barrier-wall.desc: Every 6 s you raise an invisible barrier: a shield worth 10% of your HP and a wall that pushes back enemies within 4 m.

frost-kiss.name: Icy Kiss
frost-kiss.desc: Anyone who touches you is charmed. Your hits on charmed enemies gradually freeze them.

motor-drive.name: Motor Drive
motor-drive.desc: Every time you paralyze an enemy you gain +2% damage for 4 s (up to 15 stacks).

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.desc: +15% speed. While running, every 0.5 s you ram the enemies in front of you (2.5 m): damage and a good shove.

imposter.name: Transformation
imposter.desc: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 30 s you copy the types of the nearest enemy: your type bonus and your weaknesses change.

download.name: Download
download.desc: +12% special damage and projectile speed. Every 10 s you download data: your next 5 hits are crits.

spiral-shell.name: Spiral Shell
spiral-shell.desc: +20 armor. Your Rock and Water attacks deal +15% damage. Every 5 s, a ring of rocks bursts from your shell (5 m; Omastar 6.5 m).

ancient-wings.name: Prehistoric Wings
ancient-wings.desc: +15% speed and +1 jump; you glide by holding Jump. While airborne, your attacks deal +25% damage.

ice-pressure.name: Frigid Pressure
ice-pressure.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every second, enemies within 6 m gradually freeze.

volt-pressure.name: Electric Pressure
volt-pressure.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 5 s three lightning bolts strike nearby enemies and paralyze them.

flame-pressure.name: Fiery Pressure
flame-pressure.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 6 s a 6 m ring of flames burns the enemies.

genome.name: Genome
genome.desc: +15% damage, area and speed. Every 8 s a psychic barrier gives you a shield worth 15% of your HP. Your crits stun.

descs: Six thorny roots burst from the ground in a star shape and root everything they cross.
Eight roots and a ray of sunlight that heals you for 20% while the spores put nearby enemies to sleep.
Ten roots, the sun and a giant flower that opens around you in three waves of petals.
A column of fire engulfs you and bursts into a ring that burns and leaves the ground ablaze.
Three rings of fire and six magma fissures that spit flames.
Fourteen fireballs rain down on the enemies and it all ends in an enormous explosion with magma cracks.
You spin inside your shell: a whirlpool drags in nearby enemies, hits them non-stop and ends in a wave.
A giant wave spreads out from you in a circle, drags everyone along and leaves rain.
A wave and two water cannons that sweep 360° around you.
You throw eight silk nets around you: they trap and damage anyone who steps on them for 4 s.
The cocoon hardens: 4 s of invulnerability, a 40% shield and repelling waves, with a burst at the end.
A cloud of butterflies and colorful scales puts to sleep, paralyzes and poisons over a huge area and ends in a gale.
Two rings of 24 stingers shoot out in every direction and poison.
The cocoon hardens with a 35% shield and a 6 m toxic cloud surrounds you for 4 s.
Eight ghost Beedrill fly with you for 4 s and dive down with their stingers.
A whirlwind advances 16 m toward your target, dragging along and hitting everything it finds.
Two tornadoes in a fan and a gust of wind that pushes back nearby enemies.
Three tornadoes and a flock of Pidgeot diving down on the enemies.
You jump from enemy to enemy biting 7 in a row, invulnerable while it lasts.
Twelve bites in a row; enemies left below 30% HP drop instantly (not bosses). It ends with a bite that cracks the ground.
A 20 m wind drill pierces everything in a straight line and cracks the ground.
The drill and five Fearow swooping down from the sky.
A spiral of poison pulls everyone toward you and squeezes them: damage, poison and root.
Arbok's eye paralyzes everyone within 20 m for 3 s; then three waves of mud and toxic geysers.
The sky charges up: for 2.4 s lightning rains non-stop on nearby enemies, and at the end three enormous thunderclaps.
You zigzag through the enemies wrapped in electricity and unleash an even longer storm.
You sink underground (invisible) and emerge with a tremor that stuns, four fissures and rock spikes.
Eight 16 m fissures run across the ground raising rock spikes, and a sandstorm breaks out.
You sow 14 toxic spikes around you that burst on contact, and gain a 20% shield.
A ring of toxic geysers protects you for 4 s and you gain a 30% shield.
A Body Press that cracks the ground and stuns, Earth Power geysers under 12 enemies and a 40% shield.
A 16 m charge with the poisoned horn pierces everything in front.
The charge ends in a drill that finishes off enemies below 25% HP (not bosses).
Three stomps: each one a bigger earthquake and three poisonous fissures ahead; the last one, a Megahorn.
An enormous moon appears above you: eight moonbeams fall on the enemies (charm) and you recover 20% HP.
The moon brings a rain of 16 stars and ends in an enormous lunar wave; you recover 30% of HP.
Nine will-o-wisps spin around you and each launches itself at an enemy: they burn and curse.
Nine fire tails sweep the ground in a star shape, eighteen will-o-wisps hunt for enemies and a millennial grudge curses and confuses everything within 15 m.
You sing a lullaby that puts everyone within 15 m to sleep for 2 s; then a final shout wakes the sleepers with a blow (+80% damage).
The lullaby puts everyone to sleep and you inflate like a balloon: three huge bounces crush the sleepers with ever-bigger waves.
Seven Zubat emerge from the darkness and bite non-stop for 3.5 s: they poison and every bite heals you.
A cloud of Golbat confuses with Supersonic and bites for 4 s; at the end you recover 25% HP.
A 12 m pollen cloud surrounds you for 2.5 s: it poisons, paralyzes or puts to sleep everything that breathes, at random.
A terrible 10 m stench accompanies you for 4 s: it poisons, confuses and pushes enemies away.
A giant flower opens at your feet, pollen rains on fourteen enemies and heals you for 15%.
Twelve mushrooms sprout around you and burst into spore clouds that put enemies to sleep and damage them.
Mushrooms sprout under sixteen enemies: the infected fall asleep and for 4 s the fungus drains their life for you.
Your compound eyes mark twelve enemies and you fire a Psybeam at each one: they get confused.
Six Venomoth surround you and shed scales that confuse and poison; it ends in an 18 m silver wind.
Ten Diglett pop up one after another under the enemies and launch them into the air (stun).
Three fissures advance toward your target, twenty Dugtrio pop up under the horde and the ground shakes three times.
Twenty gold coins rain down on the enemies: they hit, stun for an instant and leave ₽ on the ground.
The jewel on your forehead glows: six jewel beams spin around you and coins rain on the enemies.
You hold your head and three ever-bigger psychic waves burst, confusing.
The psychic waves and twelve water geysers that burst under the enemies, soak them and launch them into the air.
You jump from enemy to enemy throwing eight furious punches that stun, invulnerable while it lasts.
Twelve chained punches, a rain of rage fists and a final stomp that cracks the ground; the more damaged you are, the stronger it hits.
Six charges at extreme speed from enemy to enemy, leaving the ground in flames.
Ten flaming charges, columns of sacred fire on twelve enemies and a final ring of fire.
A giant spiral spins beneath your feet: it puts everyone within 13 m to sleep and ends in a wave.
The spiral turns into a whirlwind that drags in and hits for 2 s and puts the enemies it catches to sleep.
The whirlwind, three enormous Dynamic Punches on the strongest enemies (they confuse) and a final wave.
You teleport five times next to the enemies and a psychic wave bursts each time.
A giant spoon bends over you: everything within 15 m freezes for 1 s and is then slammed into the ground.
Two spoons, everything within 16 m freezes in place and sixteen Future Sight columns fall on the enemies.
Three bursts of karate chops sweep the front in a fan and push everyone back.
You jump very high and come down with all your weight: an enormous fissure stuns and launches everyone within 11 m.
Four arms strike in all four directions three times and it all ends in a Dynamic Punch that confuses.
Ten vine whips burst out in a star shape and lash everything they touch: they damage and root.
Whips and a rain of gastric acid on twelve enemies that leaves puddles: anyone who steps in them takes +25% damage.
A giant mouth appears in front, swallows every nearby enemy in one gulp and leaves a puddle of acid.
Ten tentacles burst from the ground beneath the enemies, lash them, poison them and trap them.
Sixteen tentacles, a poisonous tide that spreads out from you in a circle, and it starts to rain.
You curl up and roll 18 m toward your target, crushing and stunning everything you cross.
The roll, an avalanche of fourteen rocks on the enemies and six rocks rolling in all directions.
The roll and the avalanche end in an enormous explosion (without losing your Pokémon) that cracks the ground in a star shape.
You gallop in a circle leaving a 9 m ring of fire that burns and, when it closes, scorches everything inside.
The gallop, three fan-shaped fire trails and columns of sacred fire on the enemies.
A huge yawn puts everything within 14 m to sleep; shortly after, a psychic rain falls on ten sleepers (sleepers take ×1.8).
Your yawn and the Shellder on your tail bite eight enemies; it ends in a psychic geyser that confuses within 13 m.
A field of orbiting magnets pulls everyone within 12 m toward you and bursts in a discharge that paralyzes.
Several Magnemite accompany you and unleash lightning on the enemies while the magnetic field drags them in.
Three rings of spinning leeks burst out of you in all directions. With Maturity, leeks also rain from the sky and at the end a giant leek falls and cracks the ground.
You dash from enemy to enemy delivering nine double pecks, invulnerable while it lasts.
Three parallel 20 m charges devastate the front, then twelve triple pecks from enemy to enemy.
The ground is covered with ice within 13 m: enemies skate outward, gradually freeze and shards burst at the end.
Aurora beams fall on twelve enemies and freeze them, a frozen wave sweeps 15 m and it starts to hail.
A wave of mud spreads out from you in a circle up to 14 m, poisons everyone and leaves toxic puddles.
You melt into a giant 9 m puddle that pulls in, poisons and traps for 2 s, and bursts into mud geysers.
You shut yourself in your shell (30% shield) and when you open it you fire two rings of 20 pearls that freeze.
The shell, eighteen icicles falling from the sky on the enemies and a ring of ice spikes around you.
A 12 m cloud of poison gas engulfs you for 2.5 s: it curses (+25% damage taken) and poisons everything that breathes.
Fourteen shadow hands burst from the ground beneath the enemies, grab them (root) and curse them.
Six Gengar emerge from your shadow and leap at the enemies while Shadow Balls rain down; cursed enemies take double.
Onix rises from the ground in a circle around you, raising rocks and fissures that stun. With Maturity it goes around twice and rocks fall from the sky.
A giant pendulum swings over you: everything within 14 m falls asleep and then three psychic waves hit the sleepers (+80%).
The pendulum puts everyone within 16 m to sleep and you eat their dreams: each sleeper takes a huge hit and heals you (up to 30%).
Two giant pincers cut the ground in an X toward your target: 14 m fissures that stun, and a wave at the end.
The X-shaped fissures and a giant pincer fall on the three strongest enemies (stun) amid water geysers.
You roll from enemy to enemy eight times and every impact bursts into sparks that paralyze.
You charge up with electricity and explode without fainting: a 15 m explosion with eight electric fissures; with Maturity, Voltorb dive down and burst.
Fourteen eggs rain down on the enemies: when they break they release a psychic wave that confuses.
A giant palm tree grows above you, heals you for 15% and drops twelve giant eggs that stun; the leaves cut nearby enemies.
Eight bones spiral out up to 12 m and return to you, hitting on the way out and on the way back.
You smash the ground with a giant bone club: six fissures with ghost flames and a rain of dark bones that curse.
You jump from enemy to enemy with six kicks and finish with a High Jump Kick from the sky that cracks the ground. With Maturity, more kicks and a bigger crater.
Punches of fire, ice and lightning fall in turns on nine enemies (burning, freezing and paralyzing) and it ends with a giant Focus Punch from the sky. With Maturity, more hits.
Your tongue sweeps 360° around you (12 m): it pulls in and paralyzes everything it touches. With Maturity it sweeps twice and ends with a Heavy Slam that stuns.
A 9 m toxic cloud grows around you for 1.6 s, poisoning everyone, and then bursts in an enormous explosion.
Two clouds (yours and another in front), a gigantic detonation and eight chain explosions on the enemies.
You charge 18 m toward your target, trampling everything: it launches enemies into the air, stuns and leaves a trench of rocks.
The charge ends in a drill horn that pierces the ground and unleashes a rain of twelve rocks on the enemies.
Giant eggs fall on the enemies (6, 8 or 10 with Maturity): they burst, charm, and each one heals you for 4%. At the end, a wave of affection heals you for another 15%.
Your vines trap everyone within 13 m (more with Maturity), pull them toward you and squeeze them for 1.5 s; then the tangle bursts into leaves.
Mother and baby jump from enemy to enemy: a big punch and a small one on each (8, 10 or 12). It ends with a Mega Punch that cracks the ground.
You spit a 12 m cloud of ink that blinds everyone (charm) and fire twelve ink balls in all directions.
The ink, two whirlpools advancing toward your target and a dragon water jet falling from the sky on the strongest enemy.
Six Goldeen leap out of the water and pounce on the enemies for 3 s while waterfalls crash on eight of them.
Three horn charges in three directions, followed by six Seaking diving down and waterfalls on ten enemies.
You launch yourself spinning like a star that bounces from enemy to enemy ten times, faster each time.
The star bounces fourteen times and your core fires a beam of light that sweeps 360° around you.
You raise invisible walls in a circle: they trap everyone inside, immobilize them and burst into crystals that confuse. With Maturity the box is bigger and ends in a mist explosion that charms.
You cut through the horde in one slash after another (8, 11 or 14), leaving cuts in the air; half a second later all the cuts burst at once.

You dance an icy waltz: you blow kisses at twelve enemies that charm and freeze them, and a circling blizzard leaves them frozen. With Maturity, more kisses and ice crystals sprouting from the ground.
You jump from enemy to enemy throwing six thunder punches that paralyze, and finish with an enormous bolt on yourself. With Maturity, more punches and a final electric storm.
A volcano erupts beneath your feet: star-shaped magma fissures and a rain of fireballs on the enemies. With Maturity, more fissures and balls and a final eruption that wipes out everything.
Your pincers grab the three strongest enemies, lift them and slam them into the ground with a fissure that stuns. With Maturity you grab more and finish with an X-shaped guillotine.

A herd of five ghost Tauros gallops across the field toward your target: they trample, stun and launch everything they catch into the air. With Maturity the herd is bigger and comes back in a second crossing charge.
You jump three times with all your might: each landing raises an enormous wave, and at the end Magikarp rain from the sky.
Gyarados roars and charms everyone, two waterspouts advance toward your target and a Hyper Beam sweeps the front. With Maturity it starts to rain and a wave finishes it off.
You sing a lulling melody: the ground is covered with freezing ice and a huge wave full of icebergs sweeps everything around you. With Maturity the wave is bigger and ice columns sprout.
You transform and copy the Ultimate of a random League member, with your own strength.
A rain of Quick Attack stars falls on twelve enemies and ends in a charge that cracks the ground.
It depends on your evolution. Vaporeon: a tidal wave and Acid Armor (you heal 25%). Jolteon: electric pin missiles and a storm. Flareon: a fire star and blazes.
The world glitches: scan lines sweep 14 m, everything freezes for an instant and ten data cubes fall, bursting and cursing. With Maturity, more cubes and a data beam that sweeps 360°.
A spiral of fossil shells and rocks bursts out around you, traps whatever it touches and ends in a geyser.
The spiral, Omastar's tentacles drag in the horde and sixteen shell spikes rain from the sky.
You spin inside your shell for 1.6 s surrounded by four blades that strike non-stop, and finish with a splash.
You jump from enemy to enemy with six slashes and two X-shaped fissures cut the ground around you.
You soar high and dive down with a wave of ancient rocks; with Maturity, three dives and a flock of Aerodactyl.
You yawn (putting nearby enemies to sleep), jump and come down with all your weight: an earthquake that cracks the ground. With Maturity, two slams, fissures and Rest (you heal 30%).
A 3 s blizzard covers the map: icicles fall on the enemies, everything within 18 m gradually freezes and finally freezes solid; it starts to hail. With Maturity, three Articuno sweep the field.
Zapdos unleashes a 3 s storm: lightning strikes non-stop and five enormous thunderclaps hit the strongest. With Maturity, three Zapdos dive down and it rains.
Moltres spreads its wings: sixteen fireballs rain down, the earth cracks into magma and you are reborn with 30% HP. With Maturity, three Moltres dive down.
A cyclone of draconic flame advances 16 m toward your target, dragging along and hitting.
Dragonair's orbs: three dragon rings burst out of you, the weather changes to rain and two cyclones sweep the front.
Dragonite calls down the comets: twelve Draco Meteors fall from the sky, three Dragonite swoop down and a hurricane finishes it off.

Everything within 22 m stops for 1.2 s, marked by your mind; then psychic columns crush sixteen enemies and a mental wave bursts. With Maturity, Psystrike orbs chase the strongest and a barrier protects you.
A psychic bubble protects you (30% shield) and Mew copies the Ultimate of another random League member; with Maturity, two and then three in a row.

fusions.name: Flower Beam
fusions.desc: Gathers sunlight and fires a solar beam from which sharp leaves sprout on both sides; where it ends, an explosion of petals blooms.

fixed: The leaves pierce 2 enemies.

fusions.name: Fiery Whirlwind
fusions.desc: Launches a fire whirl that pulls in enemies and feeds it with a Flamethrower: it grows, spits spiraling flames and explodes.

fusions.name: Hydro Spiral
fusions.desc: You spin inside your shell and push nearby enemies away while two Hydro Pump jets sweep everything around you like a sprinkler.

fusions.name: Ball Storm
fusions.desc: Launches a big electric ball that floats over the horde and acts as a lightning rod: thunder strikes it and chains outward until it falls and explodes.

fixed: A thunderbolt strikes the ball every 0.3 seconds.

fusions.name: Resonant Web
fusions.desc: Throws silk webs that stick to the ground and trap; then a buzz makes them vibrate and each web releases a sound wave that punishes the trapped more.

fixed: The waves sound twice and trapped enemies take 50% more damage.

fusions.name: Lethal Sting
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm of Beedrill that dive with their stingers; where they sting they leave toxic spikes on the ground.

fusions.name: Feather Cyclone
fusions.desc: A hurricane advances on the enemies dragging them along, and cutting wings fly out of it nonstop, back and forth.

count.text: Cutting Wings: come out faster (rate ×2 at +2, ×3 at +4)

fixed: The wings pierce all enemies.

fusions.name: Ravenous Chomp
fusions.desc: Fangs leap from enemy to enemy biting each one; each bite also tears away 6% of its remaining health (not bosses).

fixed: Each enemy takes only one bite per cast.

fusions.name: Celestial Drill
fusions.desc: A drill beak falls from the sky onto the enemy, sinks into the earth and comes out again beneath three others, one after another.

fusions.name: Corrosive Grime
fusions.desc: A pile of garbage falls on the enemies and leaves an acid puddle that poisons and corrodes: those who step in it take more damage.

fusions.name: Seismic Ball
fusions.desc: A rock ball rolls in circles around you; each bounce shakes the ground and at the end it lands with a great earthquake.

fusions.name: Toxic Tide
fusions.desc: A wave of poison leaves you in a circle; enemies that were already poisoned burst into splashes that infect those beside them.

fixed: At most 12 poisoned enemies burst.

fusions.name: Tectonic Horn
fusions.desc: A ghostly horn charges in a straight line and splits the ground: along the fissure, earth geysers burst one after another.

fusions.name: Gravitational Moon
fusions.desc: A small moon appears over the enemies and pulls them in with its gravity; then it falls and bursts into star shards.

fusions.name: Nine-Tail Dance
fusions.desc: Nine will-o'-wisps spin around you like tails and launch one by one at the enemies; each bursts into a ring of psychic fire that burns and confuses.

fusions.name: Grand Concert
fusions.desc: A lullaby puts the surrounding enemies to sleep and, once they are asleep, a huge booming voice hits them hard and wakes them.

fusions.name: Vampire Wing
fusions.desc: A supersonic echo marks the surrounding enemies and air blades seek the marked and return part of the life they steal.

fixed: Healing is capped at 1.5% of your max HP per cast.

fusions.name: Dancing Garden
fusions.desc: The petals spinning around you open into a spiral storm and close again; they hit on the way out and back and leave clouds of poison dust.

fixed: Leaves 4 clouds of poison powder.

fusions.name: Fungal Bomb
fusions.desc: Throws energy balls that make a mushroom sprout where they land; the mushroom releases sleep spores and soon bursts.

fusions.name: Scale Prism
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of silver scales ahead and fires a signal beam at it: the scales refract it into a fan of colored beams.

fixed: The fan always covers the same angle.

fusions.name: Dugtrio's Fissure
fusions.desc: A fissure runs along the ground toward the enemies; along it Diglett and Dugtrio pop up and spit mud at those nearby.

fusions.name: Golden Rain
fusions.desc: Coins rain on the surrounding enemies, then you leap into a playful scuffle in a dust cloud where they pile up most.

fusions.name: Torrential Migraine
fusions.desc: A jet soaks the enemies ahead and Psyduck's headache bursts into psychic orbs on the wet ones, splashing those beside them.

fixed: Psychic orbs only fall on wet enemies.

fusions.name: Unleashed Tantrum
fusions.desc: Throws fists of rage that chase the enemies, and every hit makes the ground tremble. The less health you have left, the harder it hits.

fixed: Hits up to 60% harder the less HP you have left.

fusions.name: Fiery Stampede
fusions.desc: A fire silhouette leaves you at full speed and zigzags between several enemies leaving a burning trail; at the end it explodes.

fusions.name: Hypnotic Spiral
fusions.desc: A great hypnotic spiral turns on the ground and pulses, lulling enemies to sleep, while bubble beams spiral out of it.

fusions.name: Prismatic Premonition
fusions.desc: Marks several enemies with runes; shortly after, rifts open in the air around them and Psybeams converge on them.

fixed: Psybeams follow the marked enemy.

fusions.name: Four-Arm Combo
fusions.desc: Four lightning-fast strikes in a cross against four enemies and, to finish, a Dynamic Punch whose shockwave confuses everything nearby.

fusions.name: Carnivorous Whip
fusions.desc: Throws vines that catch up to three enemies and drag them toward you; then acid jaws bite everything around you.

fusions.name: Jellyfish Whirl
fusions.desc: A whirlpool pulls in the enemies; tentacles sprout around it and poison jumps in a chain among all the trapped.

fusions.name: Magnitude 10
fusions.desc: An earthquake of random magnitude between 4 and 10: the higher it is, the harder it shakes and the more rocks fall from the sky.

fixed: The magnitude, from 4 to 10, is rolled on each cast.

fusions.name: Gloomy Curse
fusions.desc: A Shadow Ball bursts and curses; then misfortune jumps from enemy to enemy with will-o'-wisps and deals double damage to those suffering any status.

fixed: Deals double damage to enemies with any status.

fusions.name: Dance of Bones
fusions.desc: A bone and a dark bone trace figure eights around you, hitting everything they cross; the dark one leaves a trail of ghostly fire.

changelog.title: Change your password even if you don't remember the current one.

notes.text: Forgot your password but still signed in? You can now **change it without entering the current one** in Settings → Account. Each account can do this **only once**, and only if it has never changed its password before.

changelog.title: Various client improvements.
PokéBonk now has an app for Android and Mac.

notes.text: **Android app** and **Mac app**: download them for free from the **Apps** button in the menu.
The **PC app 1.4.0** **updates itself** and shows on **Discord** what you're playing, with which Pokémon and in which zone (you can turn it off in Settings → Display).
A **new, clearer** download page, with screenshots of the game itself.

changelog.title: Lavender Tower, cleaner until the event ends.

notes.text: The **Lavender Tower** anti-cheat now checks the **damage on the Beyond floors**: impossible climbs no longer stay at the top of the **event leaderboard**.

changelog.title: The server is tidying up again.

notes.text: The server **cleans out** old data nobody uses **on its own** again, so it stays **smooth** at peak hours. Your records, history and progress don't change.

changelog.title: Your Ultimate charges like it used to.

notes.text: Undid a change from v0.8.85: the kills your **Ultimate makes as it ends** **charge the next one** again, as always. With the same build, you hold out like before when the horde surrounds you.

changelog.title: New version 1.3.0 of the PC app.

notes.text: **Desktop app 1.3.0**: the Windows installer lets you **choose the folder** and creates the **shortcut**. Download it from the **App** pill in the menu.
**Linux and Steam Deck**: the app now starts on systems that closed it on launch, and right-click lets you **copy and paste**.

changelog.title: Co-op connects better and your runs are no longer lost.

notes.text: «Connecting…» is **much faster**: a direct connection is tried first and the relay is kept for those who need it. If you reload the page in a room, **you return to the same room**.
**Find a match** no longer puts you in rooms whose leader is away. The leader has **30 s** to start and the team can **vote to kick them**.
Players in **mainland China** are matched with each other, and co-op **counts for your clan's missions**.
**Save and quit** keeps a copy on your account: continue your run on **any device**. If it can't save right then, it saves as soon as it can.
If the game closes suddenly, when you come back you can **continue your run** from the last autosave. Your **build plans** and **Archive presets** are also saved to your account.
**Fewer crashes** on iPhone, iPad and PC: the game uses much less memory.
Keys, controller and joystick that got **stuck**, the Tower stairs, zoom on mobile, and **older Safari**, which can now play.
Repeated shinies, Aspects that didn't count a fusion's damage, and **two invulnerability exploits** closed.
**Desktop app**: V-Sync is now always on, so the FPS shown are real and the game runs smoothly.

changelog.title: Your runs no longer stay unranked.

notes.text: Runs the anti-cheat flagged as unusual now **count on the leaderboard right away**: we review them afterwards and only remove the ones that really are cheating.
The best scores of each map and of the Global board **no longer wait for review**: they go onto the leaderboard as soon as you finish.

changelog.title: In the desktop app, Esc no longer takes you out of fullscreen.

notes.text: **Desktop app**: pressing **Esc** no longer takes you out of **fullscreen**; now it only pauses and closes menus. To leave fullscreen, use **F11** or the fullscreen button.
To get it, download **version 1.2.0** of the app from the **App** pill in the menu: the app will let you know when you open it.

changelog.title: Kicking someone from your clan no longer sends you back to the top of the list.

notes.text: When you **kick** someone from the clan, change their rank or mute them, the member list **stays where it was** instead of jumping back to the top.

The best marks on each map and on the Global board are now **reviewed before they show up on the leaderboard**: if yours gets there, you'll see “Run under review” and we'll let you know in your mailbox.

changelog.title: You can now play PokéBonk with its official PC app.

notes.text: Free **desktop app** for **Windows** and **Linux** (also **Steam Deck**): download it from the **App** pill in the menu. macOS coming soon.
In the app: its own loading screen and **Settings → Display** with window, resolution, monitor, V-Sync and graphics backend.

«Enemies drawn» now works at the end of long runs: **Nearby** and **Very close** draw only the 300 or 120 nearest, and the new **Shadows only** draws none (they are still there; you only see their shadow). Many more FPS with huge hordes.
A run kept with **Save and quit** goes on with the **Archive** it had: changing it before resuming no longer changes that run.

changelog.title: Public rooms no longer sit waiting for a leader who never starts.

notes.text: The **leader** of a public room has **60 seconds** to press “Start!” once the team is in; otherwise they leave the room and **the next player leads**.
Everyone in the room can see how long the leader has left, and the leader gets a warning **20 seconds** before.
While you are still connecting to each other the clock stops: nobody is removed for a slow connection.
**Find a match** no longer puts you in rooms whose leader has run out of time.

changelog.title: Co-op without unfair rejections and a sharper anti-cheat.

notes.text: **Co-op** runs with the window covered or on another screen are no longer rejected for «the play time doesn't match»: the clock no longer runs fast.
**Team Survival** no longer rejects runs for «Inconsistent bosses».
A **saved run** you finish right after coming back is no longer rejected.
The **Rainbow Wing** now shows the big banner when it revives you, like the Max Revive.
The **anti-cheat** catches more cheats and more bots, without touching anyone who plays fair.

**Anti-cheat review**: **146 accounts banned for good** (95 for cheating, 46 bots and 5 for auto-play) and removed from the leaderboards. **195 reports** reviewed: 8 offensive names changed, 10 messages deleted and 3 players muted for racism.
**5 unfair bans lifted** and **18 runs restored** that had been rejected by the co-op and saved-run bugs. Sorry to everyone affected!

changelog.title: Fixes: jumping and keys, Continue, co-op rooms, boss warnings and more.

notes.text: **Jumping** that only worked once per map and **keys that got stuck** now respond properly.
**Continue** on a saved run works even if you reload the page, and you no longer come back fainted.
Abandoned **public rooms** no longer stay open, so «Find a match» takes you to rooms with people.
Bosses' **charge** line now has **red edges** and is visible on any ground, the Desert included.
If your attacks are hidden (the **H** key or Settings), you'll now always see it on screen.

On the **Coast**, Poké Balls no longer land where the tide covers them. Fixed item descriptions on **mobile**, frames in the Look challenges, type names in Chinese and Korean, and the name of Ditto's attack.

changelog.title: Team pause and a bubble reserve in co-op, the H key explained and lots of fixes.

notes.text: **Can't see your attacks or damage numbers?** It's the **H** key: it hides or shows them all at once. Now it only lasts **the run where you press it**, and if it got stuck on, you can see everything again.

The **bubble** while picking upgrades is now a **reserve**: you start with **45 seconds**, each level adds 15 (up to 90) and it slowly refills. Rerolling, banishing or skipping no longer burn it all at once.

**Team pause**: press **P** (or «Ask the team to pause» in the menu) and once everyone accepts, the run stops. The team has **5 minutes** of pause per run, and it goes on when everyone votes to resume.
A **fainted** teammate no longer deals damage, dropped connections **reconnect on their own**, and «Find a match» no longer puts you back in the room you just left.

**Shiny legendaries**: Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Mewtwo and Mew have their own per-account chance, which **rises with every attempt** until it's guaranteed. If you already have them, they come back when their shiny is due.
When you weaken a legendary, we tell you it **joins your League**. If a finished run doesn't get through (for example during maintenance), the game **keeps it and resends it** on its own.
**Save and quit** remembers the explored map and, if you saved on **another device**, tells you so and lets you discard it. New **«Stuck»** button in the pause menu.

Fixed the **Mewtwo** challenge when you rush the guardian, the slot machine **777**, the **Ultimate** when holding R or levelling up, aiming that switched on its own, the **mobile menu** covering the news, and the rivals notice in **dark theme**.

changelog.title: Various client improvements.
The logo says where the official game is: PokéBonk.com.

notes.text: The logo now shows **PokéBonk.com**: it's the game's only official website. Some sites copy PokéBonk or embed it in their pages with ads; always play on **pokebonk.com** so your account and progress stay safe.

changelog.title: Public rooms no longer get stuck with an absent leader.

notes.text: If the **leader** of a public room doesn't touch anything for **90 seconds**, they leave the room and **the next player leads**, so you can start without waiting for them.
Before leaving, the leader sees **“Still there?”** with a countdown: just move the mouse or press a key.
If you're waiting alone in the search and don't touch anything for **3 minutes**, the search is cancelled.

changelog.title: Find a match in co-op, a signal wheel to talk without voice, and a fairer bubble while choosing.

notes.text: **Find a match**: on the co-op screen pick a mode, team (duo, trio or squad), map and difficulty, or «Any», and we'll team you up with other trainers looking for the same, from your region first.
**Public rooms** have a **leader** (the crown) who picks the map and starts whenever you're ready. When the match ends you go back to the room to chat and play another.
In your friends' room, turn on **Find teammates** so other trainers can fill the free seats.

**Signal wheel**: hold **G** (L3 on a gamepad) and pick Here!, To the boss!, Look at this!, To the portal!, Thanks!, Wait!, Careful! or Help!. Each one places itself where it belongs. A tap of G marks the spot you're looking at.
The **bubble** while choosing upgrades gives **5 seconds per level** (up to 10) and no longer refills by itself: when it runs out, you can be hit while you choose.
Co-op is now for trainers **with an account**: if you play as a guest, it shows you how to create one in a moment, without losing your progress.

changelog.title: Save & quit in long runs, Bill's Machine in Team Survival and a new Clans screen.

notes.text: Revamped **Clans** screen for players without a clan: a finder with clans as cards and quick filters, a ranking with a podium and «Found your clan» on the side.
In **Team Survival**, **Bill's Machine** works again 11 minutes after you use it.
With a controller, the **Big map** is an action you can bind in Settings → Keys: it is on R3, or put it on Select if you prefer.
In the **Pokédex** you can view each Pokémon as normal, shiny or classic shiny, depending on which you have.
**Treasure** frames no longer make pages with many of them stutter, and the **glossary** better explains Status damage, item attacks and when a mega crit happens.
**Save & quit** now works in long runs: it got stuck on «Wait a moment».
The **Dawn Stone** is no longer wasted if you clear zone 1 before its shiny shows up: it appears in the next zone.
In **Lavender Tower**, the camera no longer turns straight down when you stand against a wall.

**Look** challenges now name the right move in Russian, French, Korean, Japanese and Chinese; in Safari the sound stops when you switch tabs, and in the co-op room the Bag no longer covers the invitations.
The **type filter** when choosing a Pokémon now counts its evolutions: Dratini shows under Flying thanks to Dragonite, and the Nidoran under Ground.
In **co-op**, if the server is very busy, your run waits longer before asking it again, so it recovers sooner for everyone.
The **Ultimate** is ready again as soon as the gauge is full, in auto mode too: the 10-second wait between Ultimates is gone.

changelog.title: Team Survival, and an Ultimate that tells you how long it needs.

notes.text: **Team Survival**: pick the Survival mode in the co-op room. A shared boss every 4 minutes, Cataclysm, Apocalypse and a horde that wipes out any team: how long can you hold out together?
Fallen teammates come back when the team beats the next boss, and there's a **team leaderboard** by time survived.
The **Ultimate** no longer looks stuck "one pixel short": after you fire one, the medallion counts down the seconds to the next, and R tells you too.
The game only saves your settings when they change: less load on the server at peak times.
The **Halloween event** screen no longer errors out when lots of people are playing.
**Co-op** and settings put much less load on the server: rooms and menus run smoother at peak times.
Fixed the **“No connection to the server”** drops when coming back from maintenance.
**The server no longer collapses** at peak times: when it's very busy it tells you right away instead of leaving you waiting, and your runs are still saved.

changelog.title: Save and quit: leave your run halfway and pick it up another day right where you left it.

notes.text: **Save and quit**: from the pause, save your run (classic, Daily Mutation or Survival) and continue it another day **exactly as it was**: the wild Pokémon, the Poké Balls, the clock and your build.
When you come back, the game asks whether to **continue** the saved run or **finish** it and keep what you earned. You can't save in the middle of a boss fight or an event.
The **League legendaries** (Mew, Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres and Mewtwo) join your League **as soon as you weaken them**. You only need the Poké Ball to keep their shiny.
**Gliding over water** no longer slows you down, neither on Storm Coast nor with Zapdos' tide.
The descriptions of several items and of **status damage** now say exactly what they do.
Runs **under 1 minute** no longer show up in your history or the rankings; their progress still counts.
Closed two **endless invulnerability** tricks: opening and closing the slot machine in co-op, and the chained automatic Ultimate.

changelog.title: Daily Mutation fixes and a sharper anti-cheat.

notes.text: **Metronome**: moves that turned into a beam no longer get stuck; they keep changing every 30 seconds in every zone.
The **Daily Mutation frames** you've already earned now show up in the **Frames** tab of the avatar picker.
On a run's build card, the **damage of each move** no longer stops at the same cap in long runs: you'll see how much each one really did.
Sharper **anti-cheat**: fewer false positives with Gengar and in co-op, and the bots flooding the Desert leaderboard no longer get through.

changelog.title: Daily Mutation: a different run every day, with its own leaderboard and prizes to keep.

notes.text: **New mode: the Daily Mutation.** Every day, a classic run with a **different twist**, the same for everyone: same map, same world and same mutation. Find it in the menu's first row, next to Survival.
Play with **any League Pokémon you like** and try as many times as you want: your **best run of the day** counts (how far you get, then your KOs). No Bag and no co-op.
**Metronome** (Nightmare): every 30 seconds one of your moves turns into a random one from the whole League, at the same level. Your first move and fusions never change.
**Dynamax Wilds** (Hard): wild Pokémon are twice as big with twice the HP; they hit 50% harder but move 15% slower. Bosses don't change.
**Candy Fever** (Hard): double experience and Pokédollars, but Pokémon get stronger 60% faster.
**Glass** (Normal): only a quarter of your HP, but all your damage is doubled.
The four take turns: each comes **once every 4 days**, never two days in a row, and moves to a new map each time. It changes at **00:00 UTC**, and the screen shows the ones coming next.
A **daily leaderboard** for each mutation, plus yesterday's and the day before's. **Stardust** once a day: 60 for zone 2, 60 for zone 3, 60 for the sanctuary and 120 for winning (300 in total).

**Prizes to keep** in every mutation: its **title** for reaching zone 3, its **avatar frame** for reaching the sanctuary and its **profile background** for winning it. With all four backgrounds, the title **King of Mutations**.
**Profile backgrounds**, a new cosmetic: the picture behind your name on your trainer card. Pick it in the **Backgrounds** tab, next to avatar, frame and title.
You can feel the mutation in the run: a banner at the start of each zone, its medallion next to the top plate and, in Metronome, a countdown and every move swap shown big.
**Slot machine**: hold **E** (or the gamepad button) to spin non-stop. Prizes pile up in a tray and you see them all when you let go or run out of Pokédollars.
**Leaderboard goals**: once you reach the prize top you no longer jump from #50 to #25: you chase **every rival, one by one** (#50, #49, #48…).
When you catch a **second shiny**, you now tap the one you **release**, just like replacing an Alpha.
The **Play** button no longer gets cut off in the menu.

changelog.title: Looks challenges in co-op, your Bag in the room and a clearer wallet.

notes.text: **Looks challenges now count in co-op**: «win» is the team's victory and each challenge looks at what you do. Only the «taking at most N hits» ones stay solo. Runs you finish from now on count.
You can now bring your **Bag** to co-op: pick your items in the room, under the difficulty. They're only used up if the run starts.
The **legendary's shiny roll** is the same for the whole team: if one of you gets it, you all do.
Falling while a teammate's connection hiccups **no longer ends the run**.
If your team beats the guardian and the portal didn't show up for you, **it now appears** after a few seconds.
The **«Ready»** window no longer stays on top of the run, and the room **connects better** when the server is busy or the network is tricky.

**New wallet** at the top centre: your **PokéDollars, bigger**, and on the same line what the **Poké Ball**, the **slot machine** and **refreshing Meowth** cost right now. Each price turns green when you can afford it.
Goodbye to the «Calm / Dangerous…» meter under the clock: **more room** on screen.
**Controller**: L3 releases the fallen Alpha, Select shows the map without pausing, and the stick no longer drifts on its own.
**Shinies**: Venusaur no longer looks normal, and **14 nearly grey Pokémon** (Geodude, Onix, Dewgong, Magnemite, Mewtwo…) get a shiny that really stands out.
**Chinese or Japanese keyboard**: if your input method blocks WASD, the game tells you how to switch it, and E and your attacks respond.
**Android**: the «back» gesture from the screen edge no longer pauses the run while you use the joystick, and the stick no longer gets stuck.
If the **picture goes black** with the interface still visible, the game tries to bring it back on its own.
**Sound effects** no longer vanish leaving only the music, and there are fewer volume spikes.
**Light Screen** looks like glass, not white squares.
The keyboard's **skip track** key no longer stops your Pokémon.

changelog.title: Fixes from your reports: shinies, challenges, older iPhones and attack effects.

notes.text: The sanctuary's **legendary shiny** is no longer lost when you already have many shinies in the same run.
The **Dawn Stone** is no longer spent without a shiny: if you clear the first zone very fast, it shows up in the next one.

The **no-evolving** challenges (Charmander, Dratini) count your form when you beat the final boss, even if its experience evolves you afterwards. **By a hair** checks your HP when you beat it, so the berry it drops no longer takes it away.
Many attacks of the newest League Pokémon came out with **another move's effect and sound** (Thunder Cage with a pink moon). They look right now.
The game opens again on **iPhone and iPad with iOS 15**, which were stuck on «Retry».
**Chansey** can learn Transformation and Mimic at the same time to make Ditto's fusion.
On the rooftop of the **Lavender Tower**, the way-down stairs ask you to confirm before ending the run.
The summary of a co-op run reminds you that **Looks challenges** only count in solo.
**View my team** (Tab on level-up) also shows what each attack's level-up upgrades add up to.
Fewer honest runs sent to review: **co-op**, gold and long runs get more leeway.

changelog.title: Clan prizes for everyone who contributes, password change in Settings and boss health as a percentage.

notes.text: **Clan season prizes**: you no longer need 2% of the clan's total. **500 points and a quarter of the average** of the members who scored is enough: if everyone contributes about the same, **everyone gets it**. In the Clan tab, "Your contribution" shows how many points you have and how many you need.
You can now **change your password** in Settings → Account. Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
Settings → Interface → **Boss health**: boss bars can show the **percentage** they have left instead of HP.
In the pause menu, Stats show how much a **mega crit** deals and make clear that crit damage **has no cap**.

In the Clan tab, **Clan slots** and **Season prizes** are no longer squashed; "From levels" says **hits** for melee attacks, and the **Change** button is better translated in English, Japanese and Korean.

changelog.title: Solo runs save again on every browser.

notes.text: **Solo runs** now save even if your browser doesn't keep data (some tablets and apps): before, the server couldn't save them and their rewards and catches were lost.
In the **Lab**, every item you haven't unlocked yet says **how many copies** you can take into a run.

changelog.title: Much better clan rewards, new avatar frames and fixes from your reports.

notes.text: **Much better clan rewards**: each mission star gives up to **2,000 Stardust** and a Bag item, and the third one a **Bonkoin**. Winning the rivalry gives **1,500 Stardust, 2 Bonkoins and a Master Ball**.
**Three clan avatar frames**, each with its title: **Clan Star**, **Unbeaten Rival** and **Legendary Clan**. See them in the Clan tab.
The **Aspect frames** you own can be worn as your avatar frame.
The **Shop** tells you how many items fit in your Bag and how many you can still buy.
Attack cards show the **minimum cooldown** (0.12 s) and tell you when an attack cannot get any faster.
The **Lickitung** challenge asks for **7,000 HP** healed in one run (it was 8,000).

A **room** no longer opens in the middle of a solo run, the same Pokémon can no longer be **caught** several times, the **next map** unlocks without remaking the room, and a teammate fainted in mid-air **falls to the ground** so you can revive them.

Fixed: the **Korean keyboard** (A/S/D), the **Release** button on mobile, the **Golden Magikarp** challenge, extra **Bonkoins** that dropped without being paid, and going back to Seen and Families in the Pokédex.

changelog.title: A bigger Archive as you unlock items, and level-up upgrades shown in the pause.

notes.text: **Archive**: every 2 items you unlock give you **1 more slot** (up to 59). The Lab upgrade tells you how many you have and where they come from.
In the pause, each move shows **what its level-up upgrades add up to** (damage, cooldown, projectiles…).
Co-op runs no longer start by **skipping zones** when you play again with the same team.
Fewer honest runs sent to review: co-op, very long Survival runs and back-to-back short runs.
Over **100 cheating accounts and bots** removed from the leaderboards.
The event image in the menu, news covers, the Treasures background and the Lab's 4th move icon show again.

changelog.title: Altars by zone in the pause menu, Rhydon's roars on screen and clearer item stats.

notes.text: **Altars in the pause menu**: what each altar gave you, zone by zone, plus the total.
**Rhydon's roars** show on screen while its guardian is still standing.
**Stats** show the extra damage from the Metronome and friends, and items that strike on their own get their own row.
If your connection to a teammate goes through our server, it uses less data.

changelog.title: See your teammates' attacks and less waiting at peak hours.

notes.text: **See your teammates' attacks** just as they cast them. In Options → Graphics you can simplify or hide them.
Co-op rooms ask the server far less often: the game runs smoother for everyone at peak hours.
News and game status load faster.
The server holds up better during long peak hours: it no longer builds up memory over time.

changelog.title: A lighter server for peak hours.

notes.text: **Faster server** at peak hours: co-op leaderboards and rooms ask for much less.
If a teammate leaves the run, your game stops searching for them nonstop after a minute.

changelog.title: We went through over 1,000 reports: the M map, a steadier co-op, fusions explained and dark mode in runs.

notes.text: **Fusions explained**: every fusion says how it works (its parts: meteor, barrage, zone…) and what Area, Duration and Projectiles do to each part.
**Search** on the Pokémon selection screen: type its name or number.
**After beating the guardian**, an arrow and the minimap lead you to its Great Ball and then to the portal.
**Shared map**: what a teammate discovers (Poké Balls, altars, Ditto…) also shows up on your map.
**Damage per player** in the final summary and the pause menu.
Go to the **Lab** from the room without leaving the group, and come back with “Back to the room”.
If you go down just before the team takes the portal, the run no longer ends and you aren't left behind: you revive with them.
With a bad connection the team no longer splits across different zones, and the horde no longer pushes you out of an altar while you pick an upgrade.
**Dark mode across the whole run**: portrait, timer, items, moves, notices and boss bars.
“Your Team” is now called **Favorites**: they're your favorite Pokémon and change nothing in the run.
Only clan members can see the clan's **Activity** now.
Auto Ultimate shows **AUTO** on its medallion when it's on.
Mobile: Bill's Machine always shows “Not now”, and you can cancel a banish.
Low rocks can be jumped over, and rocks and trees don't trap you as much.
When you come back signed out, the game offers to sign in to your account instead of creating an empty guest.
Clan names accept more letters, the game remembers your language and the menu leaderboard remembers what you were looking at.
**Closing the map with M no longer opens the pause menu**, and “Continue” gets you back in the game on the first click.
The camera turns again after closing the shop or a menu, and keys no longer get stuck (the Pokémon that walked on its own).
Lavender Tower: floors no longer get stuck unfinished and you don't get trapped inside the boss.
The boss's Great Ball no longer lands under the portal, and Whirlpool no longer stops casting with lots of Duration.
In Survival runs over 6 hours you no longer become immortal, and huge numbers are readable.
The Meowth challenge counts all your money, plus fixes to the Shiny star, the slot machine in dark mode and the minimap arrow.
